summary: Antonelli arrives in Baku seeking to extend his championship lead against a resurgent Red Bull outfit, with Hadjar returning from injury to bolster the team's challenge on Baku's high-speed street circuit. McLaren's alarming pace deficit in Friday practice—Norris admitting the team ran "miles off"—injects uncertainty into their title fight and hands opportunity to hungry midfield rivals. A strong performance from Antonelli this weekend could build decisive momentum in the championship battle, particularly with Hadjar's return adding fresh competition to the fight.
